name: Divine Communion (Mythic)
body:
Your will is one with the will of your deity.

Prerequisite(s): Divine Communion

Benefit(s): You add 1/2 your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use Divine Communion. If you expend one use of mythic power, you double the insight bonus you gain on Wisdom.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
